svg.text: COMPLETE GATE-LEVEL SCHEMATIC: LOW-POWER ZERO-SKIPPING MAC UNIT
Pure Hardware Topology — Showing Every Gate, Reduction Tree, Multiplier Stage, Adder Cell, and Flip-Flop

g.text: • 4x Level-1 OR gates + 2x Level-2 OR gates

svg.text: 2. OPERAND ISOLATION: 16x 2-INPUT AND GATES (CLAMPS MULTIPLIER INPUTS TO 0)
When is_zero=1: All 16 AND outputs force-clamped to 0 (0 Volts)
3. 8×8 SIGNED MULTIPLIER (64 AND/NAND GATES + CSA ARRAY)

g.text: • 49 standard AND gates: pp[i][j] = iso_a[i] & iso_b[j] (for i,j < 7)
• 14 NAND gates: Sign-extension product inversion for MSBs
• 1 AND gate at MSB intersection: pp[7][7] = iso_a[7] & iso_b[7]
Adds Sum-Vector and Carry-Vector $\implies$ Generates prod[15:0]
Net LUTs: 93 LUTs (FROZEN TO ZERO TOGGLES WHEN IS_ZERO=1)
• Bit prod[15] (Sign bit) is replicated 16 times into bits [31:16]
• Bits [15:0] pass directly through $\implies$ 32-bit signed operand
32-bit Carry Chain Adder (32 Full Adder Bit-Slices)
• Full Adder Logic: Sum = A ^ B ^ Cin; Cout = (A&B) | (Cin&(A^B))
• In Silicon: Maps directly to 8x 4-bit Fast Dedicated CARRY4 Blocks

svg.text: 5. 32-BIT ACCUMULATOR REGISTER BANK (32x DFF WITH CE)

g.text: • When is_zero=1: CE deasserts LOW $\implies$ Master-slave latches disconnect
• Eliminates 100% of clock-tree & register dynamic toggling for all 32 bits
• Global inputs: clk (100 MHz oscillator) and clr (Synchronous channel reset)
Total Registers: Exactly 32 Flip-Flops (0% FF area overhead)

svg.text: 32-BIT ACCUMULATOR FEEDBACK LOOP (acc[31:0] to Adder Port B)
